HowToUse.title: How to use
HowToUse.lead: This admin console lets you trigger deploys, index updates and other operations from the browser. No GitHub account is required.
HowToUse.step1Body: When you open the console URL, the Cloudflare Access sign-in page appears. Enter your authorized email address and you'll receive a one-time PIN. Enter the PIN to complete sign-in.
HowToUse.step2Body: After sign-in, you'll see the list of sites. Click any card to open that site's detail page. Each card shows badges for the actions available on that site.
HowToUse.step3Title: 3. Select an action and run it
HowToUse.step3Body: On the detail page, the tabs at the top let you switch between actions. The center panel shows the action description, optional inputs, and the run button. Click the run button and confirm to start the job on GitHub Actions.
HowToUse.step3Caption: Detail page: select and run an action
HowToUse.step4Body: Once started, the run appears in the history on the left. Select a running entry to see live job logs on the right. The view auto-refreshes every 5 seconds until the job completes (green check for success, red X for failure).
HowToUse.step5Body: The left list shows the last 20 runs. Click any past run to inspect its jobs and logs after the fact.
HowToUse.trouble1Body: If you see 'Access denied' on the sign-in page, your email address may not be in the allow list. Contact your administrator.
HowToUse.trouble2Title: Nothing happens when I click run
HowToUse.trouble2Body: Could be a network issue or expired session. Reload the page and try again. If the problem persists, contact your administrator.
HowToUse.trouble3Body: Check the log on the right. Configuration errors ('permission denied', 'ES_URL is not set' etc.) should be reported to your administrator. Data errors (missing required fields, broken references) can be fixed at the data source and re-run.
